apscp: Decision Support Tool for the Antarctic Peninsula

Interactive decision support tool to navigate management options for the Antarctic Peninsula. The tool identifies priority areas for implementing policies for conservation, tourism, and scientific research. To achieve this, it leverages previously published data (Lee et al. 2024) and multi-objective optimization techniques through the prioritizr package (Hanson et al. 2025). Although default parameters are specified based on stakeholder surveys, users can calibrate weights and representation targets to fine tune optimization procedures according to their own preferences. Optimization procedures can be performed with the ‘Gurobi’ (https://www.gurobi.com/) or ‘CBC’ (via the ‘rcbc’ package, https://github.com/dirkschumacher/rcbc) exact algorithm solvers.

Contributing

The application is a Shiny web application developed using the R statistical computing environment. Specifically, it uses the golem framework. This means that the application is effectively an R package that contains code for defining and launching the application (see here for more details). The R code files (located in the ./R directory) are organized using the following naming conventions:

  • app_*: Defines the web application:
    • app_config.R: Imports configuration settings.
    • app_global.R: Initializes the application. It performs a similar to the global.R file in typical Shiny applications.
    • app_server.R: Defines the (back-end) server-side logic for the application. It performs a similar role to the server.R file in typical Shiny applications.
    • app_ui.R: Defines the (font-end) user interface for the application. It performs a similar role to the ui.R file in typical Shiny applications.
  • server_*: Defines components used to assemble the server-side logic for the application.
  • ui_*: Defines functions used to create user interface elements.
  • class_*: Defines R6 object classes for managing data. used in the back-end of the application.
  • fct_*: Defines functions for analysis and data manipulation.
  • widget_*: Defines custom htmlwidgets widgets for user interface used by the application.
  • utils_*: Defines utility functions.
